observation_summary: Newssite earnings calendar integration, ArXiv LaTeX cleanup, arxiv-collector marked complete
actions_taken: Two improvements. (1) PRRJECT_FATBABY: wired earningscal.Store into newssite Handler; /section/earnings now displays a 30-day upcoming earnings table (ticker, date, period, confirmed/announced/expected status, BMO/AMC timing) above historical EPS results. Added UpcomingEarningsView type, updated EarningsSectionView, updated RenderEarningsPage signature, updated earnings template with table styling, added --earnings-cal-dir flag to newssite cmd. Commit 609a293. (2) EMILY: cleanAbstract function strips raw LaTeX macros from arxiv abstracts (\cmd{content}→content, \begin/\end environments, math blocks, bare commands, stray braces); applied in parseAtom; 4 new tests. Marked arxiv-collector complete in defaultRoadmap — all four collector roadmap items now complete. Commit 07fb0ca.
notes: All collector roadmap items complete: reddit-collector, wikipedia-collector, quality-scorer, arxiv-collector. EMILY roadmap now has only prime-triage (always-on) active. Newssite earnings calendar requires var/earnings-calendar/dates.ndjson to exist (populated by cmd/earnings-calendar daemon). All tests green.
